subject.title: feat: add external archive provider sync

question: Should Slacrawl permanently support a generic locally executed external-archive provider protocol with `[[providers]]` configuration and durable checkpoint semantics?
rationale: The implementation adds a new user-facing source, subprocess trust boundary, persistent state, and compatibility contract that tests alone cannot calibrate.

options.title: Approve the bounded provider contract
options.body: Accept the generic JSONL provider surface after rebase, real-run upgrade proof, and removal of the release-owned changelog edit.

options.title: Narrow the supported surface first
options.body: Keep the PR open but reduce or document the provider/checkpoint contract before accepting it as a stable extension point.

options.title: Defer generic providers
options.body: Pause this feature until maintainers choose a broader archive-import or plugin strategy.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded provider contract
recommendation.body: Accept the generic JSONL provider surface after rebase, real-run upgrade proof, and removal of the release-owned changelog edit.
